questions.q: How did the passengers on the Mongolia pass the time when the sea was calm?
choices: With music, dancing, and games
By fishing over the side of the ship
By reading in the ship's large library
With lessons in Arabic and Hindustani

questions.q: What happened on board when the wind made the Mongolia roll?
choices: The captain stopped the engines until the storm passed
The ladies went below and the pianos fell silent
Everyone gathered on deck to watch the waves
Fogg went up to speak with the ship's officers
questions.evidence: Then the ladies speedily disappeared below; the pianos were silent

questions.q: How did Fogg act while the Mongolia crossed the Red Sea?
choices: He nervously watched the wind and waves all day
He stayed calm and showed no sign of any worry
He spent hours on deck admiring the old towns
He grew seasick and stayed in his cabin in bed
questions.evidence: he did not betray the fact by any outward sign

questions.q: Who were Fogg's whist partners on the Mongolia?
choices: A tax-collector, a clergyman, and a brigadier-general
Fix, Passepartout, and the captain of the steamer
Three rich young Englishmen on their travels
The purser, the engineer, and a ship's doctor
questions.evidence: A tax-collector, on the way to his post at Goa; the Rev. Decimus Smith

questions.q: What did Passepartout wrongly believe during the voyage?
choices: That Fix was secretly working for Mr. Fogg
That his master's whim would surely end at Bombay
That the Mongolia would sink in the Red Sea
That he would be paid double wages for the whole trip
questions.evidence: consoled himself with the delusion that his master's whim would end at Bombay

questions.q: What did Fix tell Passepartout about himself on board?
choices: That he was a detective from Scotland Yard
That he was a merchant who sold coffee in Mocha
That he was an agent of the Peninsular Company
That he was a soldier rejoining his regiment
questions.evidence: I am one of the agents of the Peninsular Company.

questions.q: Why did Fix keep offering Passepartout drinks in the steamer bar-room?
choices: To gain the servant's confidence
Because he was lonely and wanted a friend
To make Passepartout miss the boat at Aden
Because Fogg had paid him to look after his servant
questions.evidence: the latter making it a point to gain the worthy man's confidence

questions.q: What did Passepartout think the town of Mocha looked like?
choices: A giant sandcastle on a beach
A huge coffee-cup with a saucer
A crown sitting on top of a hill
An old fort made of gingerbread
questions.evidence: it looked like an immense coffee-cup and saucer

questions.q: The Strait of Bab-el-Mandeb has a name that means what in Arabic?
choices: The Gate of Gold
The Bridge of Tears
The Road of Kings
The Mouth of Storms
questions.evidence: which means in Arabic The Bridge of Tears

questions.q: Why did the Mongolia stop at Steamer Point near Aden?
choices: To repair damage from the storms
To pick up the Indian mails
To take in coal for the engines
To let off the brigadier-general

questions.q: After walking around Aden, what did Passepartout decide about travel?
choices: It is by no means useless if you want to see something new
It is far too tiring and he would rather stay at home
It is only worth doing if you can stay a long time
It is dangerous and his master should turn back now
questions.evidence: I see that it is by no means useless to travel, if a man wants to see something new.

questions.q: How did the voyage from Suez to Bombay turn out for Fogg?
choices: He lost two days because of storms in the Red Sea
He arrived exactly on the day the steamer was due
He gained two days by arriving in Bombay early
He missed the steamer at Aden and had to wait
questions.evidence: This was a gain to Phileas Fogg of two days since his departure from London
